description_en: You can call this operation to fast-forward or rewind a video during playback
description_zh: 在播放视频时，可以调用此接口快进视频或后退视频
name: SkipVideoFile

parameters.help_en: Call ID. You can get the CallId from the response of the SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) operation
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: Time in milliseconds to skip to for video playback
parameters.help_zh: 跳转到对应的时间播放视频，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: skip_times

parameters.help_en:
A custom ID for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller in the callback message.

This is a string of 1 to 15 bytes
parameters.help_zh:
预留给调用方使用的ID。最终会通过在回执消息中将此ID带回给调用方。

字符串类型，长度为1~15个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en: Mobile phone number that receives the video playback
parameters.help_zh: 接收视频播放的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number
